services.name: Sunset & Harbor Cruise
services.desc: What better way is there to experience the beauty that the city by the sea has to offer than a harbor cruise? Sit back, relax and sip on a cocktail while we listen to music and explore Newport harbor. On these harbor cruises we’ll do two perimeter runs of the harbor then shoot out into the bay to see iconic views like Castle Hill lighthouse, Clingstone ‘house on the rocks’, Fort Adams and the Naval War College. Expect to see dozens of yachts, Americas Cup racing boats, classic wooden boats and whatever else the harbor has to offer that day! blurb: Guests fish for various species including lobster, bottom fish, tautog, tuna, sharks, and pelagic species on a 36' Osmond Beal built H and H Downeast style charter boat. Trips range from nearshore to offshore canyons with durations from 2.5 hours to 36 hours. The captain is USCG licensed and prioritizes safety and customer experience.
extraNote: 20% deposit required to reserve a trip · 10% discount for active duty military and veterans · 48 hour cancellation notice required or deposit forfeited · Trips fish rain or shine; only high winds cancel trips · Deposits for offshore and nearshore tuna/shark trips are non-refundable but transferable or reschedulable · Overly intoxicated passengers will be removed with no refund; glass bottles not allowed · April through December
